ui.mascot-theme.reads-the-local-evolutio: Reads the local Evolution / GNOME Calendar file. For online accounts (Google etc.) use CalDAV or an ICS subscription below. Nomi cannot write events here yet.
ui.mascot-theme.reads-through-the-calend: Reads through the Calendar app (including iCloud / Google / Exchange accounts signed in on this Mac). On first connect macOS asks whether Nomi may control Calendar. Recurring events show only the occurrence inside the range; only yesterday to 30 days ahead is read.
ui.mascot-theme.rest-assured-our-convers: Rest assured: our conversations and memories stay on this computer.

ui.mascot-theme.this-system-calendar-is-: This system calendar is not supported; use ICS / CalDAV below.

ui.mascot-theme.updates-are-only-availab: Updates are only available in the desktop app.
ui.mascot-theme.updates-come-from-github: Updates come from GitHub Releases (Cookieboty/nomi-ai). Download is automatic; install waits for your confirmation.
ui.mascot-theme.updates-the-dock-icon-ri: Updates the Dock icon right away (for this session only; Finder and Launchpad keep the default ink icon after you quit). The menu-bar icon stays a monochrome template.
ui.mascot-theme.updates-the-window-the-r: Updates the window, the running taskbar button and the tray icon right away. A taskbar pin is cached by Windows and may only change after you restart the app (sometimes you need to unpin and pin it again). The installer, executable and Start-menu / desktop shortcuts always keep the default ink icon.
ui.mascot-theme.warm-cream-with-sunset-o: Warm cream with sunset orange — the signature theme
ui.mascot-theme.what-should-you-see-when: What should you see when Nomi starts?
ui.mascot-theme.when-off-mascot-hidden-i: When off, Nomi is hidden from your desktop, no longer speaks and stops listening for the wake word; the Dynamic Island and system notifications keep working. “Close Nomi” on the toolbar turns this off too — you can turn it back on here anytime.
ui.mascot-theme.when-off-nomi-is-hidden-: When off, Nomi is hidden from your desktop, no longer speaks and stops listening for the wake word. “Show on startup” switches to Main window automatically so you can always get into Nomi. Turn her back on here anytime.
ui.mascot-theme.when-on-the-microphone-l: When on, the microphone listens continuously in the background (the status bar keeps showing “Waiting for wake word”). Each phrase is checked locally with whisper.cpp and never uploaded; requires the local engine and model.
ui.mascot-theme.windows-has-no-system-ca: Windows has no system calendar API usable without MSIX packaging. Nomi tries classic Outlook (the new Outlook is not supported); otherwise use an ICS subscription or CalDAV below for Google / iCloud / Outlook.com.
ui.mascot-theme.you-can-change-this-any-: You can change this any time in Settings → General.
ui.mascot-theme.you-can-reopen-this-guid: You can reopen this guide from Settings anytime~
ui.mascot-theme.your-data-stays-on-this-: Your data stays on this computer
